name: Hikage Sabaiban
source:
The most-terrible-ever Patchouli presents a hilarious "court game"!
Dance battles occur in the court! By the way, let's play baseball.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE244256.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有史以来最可怕的广藿香上演了一场搞笑的“法庭游戏”！
法庭上发生舞战！顺便说一下，我们去打棒球吧。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE244256.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
